en: The front of the postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a beach scene at Fläsians badplats, with many people swimming and strolling along the sandy shore amidst a forested backdrop. The top reads 'Sundsvall. Badlif vid Fläsian.' Handwritten notes are present above the printed text. The reverse side shows handwritten correspondence in Swedish, a green Swedish stamp (5 öre) with the word 'SVERIGE' and a postmark stamped 'SUNDSVALL.' The recipient's address is written as 'Herr R. Grahn, c/o Lehmanns, Stockholm.' The publisher information at the bottom lists 'ANTIKVARIAT-BOKH., O. A. ÅSTRÖM, SUNDSVALL.'
